title: Zesty Canadian Turkey Roast
description: A tangy, snappy turkey roast featuring applesauce and a citrus glaze, cooked sous vide and finished in a scallop‑shell vessel for a perfect meal‑prep ready dinner.
instructions: Season the turkey breast with salt and pepper and wrap it tightly in plastic wrap.
Place the wrapped turkey in a vacuum‑sealed bag with minced garlic, thyme, rosemary, olive oil, butter, and lemon juice.
Seal the bag using a sous‑vide machine set to 150°F (65°C) and cook for 3 hours.
Remove the turkey from the bag and pat it dry with paper towels.
Preheat a large scallop‑shell vessel over medium‑high heat and add a splash of olive oil.
Sear the turkey breast on all sides until a golden crust forms, about 2 minutes per side.
Pour the reserved applesauce into the scallop‑shell and stir gently to combine with the pan juices.
Return the seared turkey to the vessel and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15 minutes.
Let the roast rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
